answer: Use beacon-issued tickets to gate entry: each agent burns one small proof-of-work ticket bound to a single public key, so one identity equals one vertex in the trust graph and clones must pay again. A random beacon then draws a jury of twelve verifiers per epoch, and each newcomer waits 48 hours on a probationary terrace before earning full rights. An agent drifting in from the tundra of unvouched addresses must complete three verified tasks first. Forging a hundred fakes costs a hundred tickets plus days of delay, while a real agent pays once.
